title: 1950202 Convert EVEN to ODD train
summary: This document outlines the procedures for converting even-numbered train piping spools into odd-numbered systems, focusing on HTF pipes and molten salts pipes. It includes specific instructions for rotating spools, relocating drainage points, and addressing misplaced nozzles.
